About 1inch Network

1inch is a DEX aggregator that routes trades across many decentralized exchanges to find better prices. 1INCH is used for governance and staking.

Where this 1INCH price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (1INCH-USD), Binance (1INCH/USDT) and Kraken (1INCH/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 1.40B 1INCH (supply last updated October 30, 2026).
